title: origins.json — per-platform registry of catalog origins (D-14)
description: Build-time INPUT consumed by tools/build_catalog.py (EPIC-10). Lists a platform's origins (creators' apps.json); one is official (SidecarTridge, local source), the rest are remote creator URLs. Not loaded by the UI. Invariant (enforced by the batch, not expressible here): exactly one origin has official=true.

official.description: Exactly one origin per platform is true (SidecarTridge).

source.description: In-repo path to this origin's apps.json (used by the official origin).

url.description: Remote HTTPS URL to a creator's apps.json (unofficial origins, C-04/D-16).

id.description: Unique creator id (slug) within the platform; creator <-> origin is 1:1.
